usedFor: EARLY keeps activities and folders, so “Activity Created” can start a flow and “Create Activity” adds one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create a Folder” in EARLY
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting gets its own folder in EARLY, so related activities have one place.

watchOut: “Activity Updated” fires on changes to existing activities, so pick the trigger that matches what you want.
